sar_narrative: The account of SYN_5e45df1f exhibited a pattern of structured transactions consistent with efforts to evade reporting requirements. Between 2026-04-21 and 2026-04-29, the entity received 26 inbound transactions from various counterparties, including AC128276, AC513160, AC720644, AC691807, AC795205, AC128418, and AC188025. These transactions were consistently below $10,000, such as $3,594.69 on 2026-04-21 and $5,867.50 on 2026-04-29. The total inbound volume of $120,126.00 matches the declared monthly volume, but the use of multiple small deposits from distinct senders appears to be a smurfing pattern. This activity warrants further review by a human investigator.
